questions.question: Under Schedule VII of the Constitution, the subject 'Education' lies under which List ?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is the __**Concurrent List.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Under** Schedule VII of the Constitution,** the subject **'Education'** lies under the **Concurrent List.**
 
• The 7th Schedule of the Indian Constitution deals **with the division of powers between the Union government and the State government.**
 
• The Constitution provides for a **three-fold distribution of legislative subjects** between the** Union and the states,** i.e, **List-I (the Union List), List-II (the State List) and List-III (the Concurrent List),** described in this schedule:
 
 
• ​**Union List: **This List contains matters of national importance and the matters which require uniformity of legislation nationwide. This list has at present 100 subjects like defence, naturalization & citizenship, banking, foreign affairs, atomic energy, communication, census, etc.
 
• **State List**: This List contains matters of regional and local importance which require state-specific solutions and matters which permit diversity of interest. It presently contains 61 subjects like public order, police, public health and sanitation, agriculture, local government, gambling, etc.
 
• **Concurrent List:** This List contains matters on which uniformity of legislation throughout the country is desirable but is not essential. This List at present has 52 subjects like criminal law and procedure, education, civil procedure, marriage and divorce, population control and family planning, electricity, economic and social planning, etc.
 
• Originally there were
 
 
• 97 subjects in the union list but now it is 100 subjects in the union list.
 
• In the state list, there were 66 subjects but now it is 61 subjects.
 
• In the concurrent list, there were 47 subjects but now it is 52 subjects in the concurrent list.
 
 
 
 
 
• The **42nd Amendment Act of 1976 **transferred five** subjects to Concurrent List from State List**, that is, **(a) education, (b) forests, (c) weights and measures, (d) protection of wild animals and birds, and (e) administration of justice; constitution and organization of all courts except the Supreme Court and the high courts.**

questions.question: Unemployment that occurs during recessions and depressions are called as _________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Cyclical unemployment**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Cyclical unemployment** occurs when there is a lack of demand for goods and services in the economy, leading to a reduction in production and, consequently, a reduction in the workforce.
 
• This type of unemployment is directly related to the economic cycle of growth and recession.
 
• During periods of economic downturns such as recessions and depressions, cyclical unemployment tends to increase as companies reduce their output and lay off workers.
 
• It contrasts with other types of unemployment such as frictional, structural, and seasonal unemployment, which are not directly tied to the economic cycle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Disguised unemployment** refers to a situation where more people are employed than actually needed, often seen in agricultural sectors in developing countries.
 
• **Frictional unemployment** occurs when workers are temporarily between jobs or are searching for new ones.
 
• **Seasonal unemployment** occurs when people are unemployed at certain times of the year when demand for labor is lower, such as agricultural workers during the off-season.
 
• **Structural unemployment** happens when there is a mismatch between the skills of the workforce and the needs of the industry.

questions.question: Vishal decided to donate 12% of his salary to the PM Relief Fund. On the day of donation, he changed his mind and donated Rs. 4,200, which was 70% of what he had decided to donate earlier. His monthly salary is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net percentage of salary donated = 70% of 12% = 8.4%

8.4% of Salary = Rs. 4200

1% of Salary = 4200 ÷ 8.4 = Rs. 500

100% of Salary = 500 × 100 = Rs. 50,000

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 50,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d1ecf31c5ef170f2662f503cb2a727bf115184e3870a3604ec1c5fb1717e968.png] 

**Given:**

Planned donation = 12% of monthly salary

Actual donation = 70% of planned donation = Rs. 4200

**Formula Used:**

Part = (Percentage ÷ 100) × Base Value

**Calculations:**

Let Vishal's monthly salary be S.

⇒ Planned donation = (12 ÷ 100) × S = 0.12 × S

⇒ Actual donation = (70 ÷ 100) × Planned donation

⇒ 4200 = 0.70 × 0.12 × S

⇒ 4200 = 0.084 × S

⇒ S = 4200 ÷ 0.084

⇒ S = 50,000

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 50,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentages

When applying one percentage after another, the net percentage is the product of their multiplying factors. Here, 70% of 12% is equivalent to (70 ÷ 100) × (12 ÷ 100) = 8.4% of the original base.

Identifying the Base Value

The phrase '70% of what he had decided' clearly sets the base for the 70% calculation as the initial 12% planned donation, rather than the entire monthly salary.

Percentage vs Real Value Equivalence

To find a total (100%), equate the given real value (Rs. 4200) to its corresponding percentage representation (8.4%). The total is calculated as: Total = Value ÷ (Percentage ÷ 100).

Profit = 240x - 150x

⇒ 90x

Profit % = (90x/150x) × 100

= Monday + 3(Odd days) = Thursday

Hence, 31st March 2011 is “Thursday”.

x = -2, 6

Base length = 6 cm

Hypotenuse = 6 + 4 = 10 cm

questions.question: ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral whose side AB is a diameter of the circle through A, B, C and D. If ∠ADC = 129°, then what is the measure of ∠BAC?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral whose side AB is a diameter of the circle through A, B, C and D. 

∠ADC = 129°

**Concept used:**

Sum of opposite angles of a cyclic quadilateral = 180° 

Angle in a semicircle = 90° 

Sum of angles of a triangle = 180°

In ΔABC,

⇒ ∠BAC = 180° − 90° − 51° = 39°

**∴ The ∠ BAC is 39°. **

Total Man-days = 5 × 8 = 40 days for 1 man.

Total Woman-days = 4 × 12 = 48 days for 1 woman.

For 2 women, days = 48 ÷ 2 = 24 days.

Combined time for 1 man and 2 women = (40 × 24) ÷ (40 + 24) = 960 ÷ 64 = 15 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 15 days.**

questions.question: The diameter of a metallic sphere is 6 cm. The sphere is melted and drawn into a wire of uniform circular cross-section. If the length of the wire is 36 m, then what is its radius equal to?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Equate the volumes directly: Volume of Sphere = Volume of cylindrical Wire.

⇒ 4/3 × π × R³ = π × r² × h

⇒ 4/3 × 3³ = r² × 3600 (Converting 36 m to 3600 cm)

⇒ 36 = r² × 3600

⇒ r² = 1/100 ⇒ r = 0.1 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 0.1 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7b5f77fa9d43870c63533b4b73e31494e1ea68ea4081335e28e540fd434244ef.png] 

**Given:**

Diameter of the metallic sphere = 6 cm

Radius of the sphere (R) = 6 ÷ 2 = 3 cm

Length of the uniform wire (h) = 36 m

Converting length to cm ⇒ h = 36 × 100 = 3600 cm

Let the radius of the circular cross-section of the wire be r cm.

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a Sphere = 4/3 × π × R³

Volume of a Cylinder (Wire) = π × r² × h

**Calculations:**

When an object is melted and recast into another shape, the total volume remains conserved.

⇒ Volume of the cylindrical wire = Volume of the metallic sphere

⇒ π × r² × h = 4/3 × π × R³

⇒ π × r² × 3600 = 4/3 × π × 3³

Canceling π from both sides:

⇒ r² × 3600 = 4/3 × 27

⇒ r² × 3600 = 4 × 9

⇒ r² × 3600 = 36

⇒ r² = 36 ÷ 3600

⇒ r² = 1 / 100

Taking the square root on both sides:

⇒ r = √(1/100)

⇒ r = 1/10 = 0.1 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 0.1 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Principle of Recasting

When a 3D solid is melted and transformed into a completely different shape, its volume remains constant while the surface area may change.

Volume of a Sphere

The total 3D space occupied by a sphere of radius r is calculated using the standard formula V = 4/3 × π × r³.

Volume of a Cylinder

A circular wire is treated geometrically as a solid cylinder. Its volume is V = π × r² × h, where r is the radius of the circular base and h is the length or height of the wire.

questions.question: Anil is as much younger to Vivek as he is older to Tarun. If the total of the ages of Vivek & Tarun is 48 years, how old is Anil?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

1) Anil is as much younger to Vivek as he is older to Tarun.

2) The total age of Vivek & Tarun is 48 years.

**Calculation:**

Vivek - Anil = Anil - Tarun (given) ........(1)

Vivek + Tarun = 48 years (given) .....(2)

From equations (1) and (2), we get:

⇒ Vivek - Anil = Anil - Tarun 

⇒ Vivek + Tarun = 2 (Anil)

From equation (2)

⇒ 48 = 2 (Anil)

⇒ **Anil = 24**

Hence, the correct answer is **"24".**

questions.question: Bank rate is decided by which of the following agencies?

options.text: Securities and Exchange Board of India

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Reserve Bank of India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Bank Rate refers to the **official interest rate** at which **RBI will provide loans to the banking system**.
 
• Bank rate is used as a signal by the RBi to the commercial banks on RBI's thinking about what the interest rate should be.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

**Monetary Tools of RBI:**

 
 

 **REPO RATE**
 
 
**Repo denotes Re Purchase Option **- the rate by which RBi gives loans to other banks i.e., it is the rate at which banks buy back the securities they keep with RBI at a later period.

 
 
 

 **REVERSE REPO RATE**
 The rate at which RBI borrows from the bank is known as **Reverse Repo Rate**. 
 
 

 **CRR**
 **Cash Reserve Ratio**, it corresponds to the percentage of cash each bank has to keep as a cash reserve with RBI.
 
 

 **SLR**
 **Statutory Liquidity Ratio **or SLR is the minimum percentage of the deposit that a commercial bank has to maintain in the form of Liquid cash/ gold/or other.
 
 

 **OMO**
 **Open market operation** is a platform where government securities are sold and purchased by RBI.
 
 

 **BANK RATE**
 It is the official interest rate at which RBI provides a** loan to the bank** and extends **long term credit **to commercial banks.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 SEBI was established in **1988 **as a non-statutory body. The SEBI Act of **1992 granted** it statutory powers, allowing it to regulate the securities market effectively.
 
 
• The basic function of the SEBI is to protect the interest of investors in securities and to promote and regulate the securities market
